def predict(posts):
    out = []
    for p in posts:
        s = (p['img'] * 2.5) - (p['link'] * 1.0) + (2.0 if 18 <= p['hour'] <= 23 else 0.5) + sum(1 for c in p['text'] if c in "!！✨❤️😊") * 0.5
        s += (p['len'] / 100.0 if 20 <= p['len'] <= 100 else p['len'] / 300.0)
        out.append(s)
    return out
